caption: The drawing depicts a wooden box or cabinet with a slanted top and four rectangular panels on its front face. The box is rendered in shades of light to medium brown, showing the wood grain texture throughout. The top of the box is hinged at the back, allowing it to open upwards. Below the slanted lid, there are two smaller rectangular panels. Beneath these, there are two square doors side by side, each with a small round knob in the center and hinges on the outer edges, suggesting that they open outward. The sides and lower part of the box also have visible panels and wood grain details, with some shading to indicate dimension and depth. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color, making the box the sole focus of the drawing.
title: Flour Bin
